messages:
Alice Tran: Quick sync for tonight's kernel-quant rollout. Target window 22:45-01:00 UTC. Canary plan: 4% -> 15% -> 40% -> full. Primary concern: older A100 nodes overheating. We need a clear thermal routing and pin strategy.

Ben Kaur: Suggested routing: annotate canary slice with routing:thermal-priority=low-heat first, then degrade to mixed. Fallback target: matmul-stable (non-quant) to avoid perf cliffs.

Marta Silva: I'm infra on-call tonight. If we see thermal alarms I'll escalate immediately. Please add me to the incident playstep so I get pagerduty.

Evan Park: From sims: quant-kernel-v3 shows p50 +8ms on baseline, p99 +30ms. Thermal delta is about +9C on some older cards at sustained seq=3000. Recommend 10m hold for each canary stage, extend if thermal drift observed.

Sasha Iqbal: I'll prepare the announcement and the operator checklist. Draft link: https://go/release-notes/kernel-quant-v3-routing. Include rollback triggers and the pinned-engine policy.

deploybot: Preflight run for kernel-quant-v3 (requested by @Alice Tran)
- artifact-signature: ok
- checksum: ok
- unit-tests: ok
- staging-smoke: ok
- perf-delta: p50 +8ms, p90 +18ms, p99 +30ms
- thermal-smoke: older-A100 subset +9C under synthetic load
Preflight status: OK (advisory: thermal margin low). Recommended fallback: matmul-stable.

Alice Tran: Decision: proceed with canary at 22:50 UTC. Canary slices: 4% hold 10m. pin-ttl for canary group = 45m, regional rollout pin-ttl = 90m. We will not auto-advance on thermal advisory alone; manual check required.

Ben Kaur: Rollback triggers to record in the runbook:
- request error-rate > 1% for 5m
- p99 latency regression > 35ms for 5m
- thermal alarms tripped on >6% of nodes in a region
If triggered -> immediate rollback to matmul-stable, open INC#4567, notify infra on-call (@Marta Silva).

Marta Silva: Confirmed, I'll take INC#4567 if triggered. Also please tag affected nodes with label runtime:kernel-quant-v3 in incidents so we can filter.

Evan Park: Small ops note: capture the following for postmortem if we rollback: node temp histogram, kernel ABI, quant-kernel git-sha, cpu/gpu utilization heatmap, request geo distribution.

Sasha Iqbal: Add to release notes: operator checklist (smoke, p50/p90/p99, error-rate, mem, thermal), exact rollback criteria, contact matrix, and the CLI commands.

Ben Kaur: CLI snippet for ops channel (copy):
```
/deploy start --job kernel-quant-v3 --canary 4% --hold 10m --fallback matmul-stable --pin-ttl 2700
```
(2700s = 45m for canary pin)

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: kernel-quant-v3 at 1768139400 (22:50 UTC). Change window: 22:45-01:00 UTC.

Alice Tran: Two operational constraints: 1) No night cross-region cutovers without explicit sign-off from infra on-call. 2) If we pin more than 2h in any single region, we rotate canary groups to avoid hot-node saturation.

Marta Silva: I'll preemptively set thermal-tier routing to enforce low-heat preference for the canary groups. If nodes fall below safety threshold, routing will exclude them automatically.

Evan Park: One more: ensure API telemetry annotates each request with kernel_version and kernel_abi so we can slice metrics quickly. Sasha, can you include that in the notes?

Sasha Iqbal: Yep, added. Also recording incident playbook link: https://go/incidents/kernel-quant-v3-playbook.

Alice Tran: Great. I'll be in channel during rollout. If we see any of the rollback triggers we revert and file INC#4567. Thanks all. :rocket:
